guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice has the two strongest metric anomalies, socket count +39.1% (z=+7.82) and memory +31.3% (z=+6.25), and every one of the 5 worst traces has error spans in currencyservice (plus frontend, which is its caller). The CPU drops in other services (recommendationservice, productcatalogservice, frontend) look like downstream effects of requests failing, and the logs contain no lines to help distinguish socket from mem, so socket is chosen because it has the highest z-score.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the currencyservice pods to release leaked sockets and memory, then inspect its connection handling (unclosed client connections or connection pool settings) for a leak.
